heading: Document templates
description: The texts this hospital starts a prescription, a clinical note, a consent form or a discharge summary from. Every change is a new version: a document already made keeps the text it was made from.
backToList: Back to the list of templates

form.kindHint: What the template is for. It cannot be changed later, and decides which placeholders it can use.
form.name: Name
form.nameHint: Unique among the templates of its kind. Nothing about a patient.
form.bodyHint: A blank form: write nothing about a real patient here. Use the list in the toolbar to put in a placeholder, which is filled in when a document is made.
form.unknown: This kind of template does not know these placeholders: {{names}}. Remove them or pick one from the list.

preview.heading: Preview
preview.description: How a document made from this text reads, with made-up values in place of the placeholders.

create.heading: Add a template
create.description: Choose what it is for, name it, and write its text.
create.kindFirst: Choose a kind to write the text.

detail.notFoundBody: There is no such template at this hospital.
detail.errorTitle: The template could not be loaded
detail.archivedNote: This template is archived. It is not offered for a new document; documents made from it keep their text.
detail.unchanged: Nothing was changed, so no new version was made.
detail.conflict: Someone else saved version {{version}} while you were editing. Your text is still here. Saving again makes yours the newest version; theirs stays in the history below.
detail.archivedMeanwhile: This template was archived while you were editing. Restore it to save a new version.
detail.nameTaken: Another template of this kind already has that name at this hospital. It may be archived.
detail.versionLimit: This template has as many versions as one can have. Add a new template to go on from here.

versions.heading: Versions
versions.description: Every version this template has had. None is ever changed or removed, unless something was typed into one that should not be kept: its name and text can then be removed.
versions.failed: The version could not be loaded.
versions.redactedNote: The name and the text of this version were removed on {{date}} by {{name}}. Reason: {{reason}}.
versions.redactWarning: This removes the name and the text of this version for good. It cannot be undone. The version stays in the list, with who saved it and who removed it. Other versions may hold the same name or text: look at each of them. Documents already made from it keep their own text.
versions.redactConfirm: Remove the name and the text
versions.redactDone: The name and the text of {{version}} were removed.
versions.redactCurrent: The newest version is the template as it is used. Save a corrected version first, then redact this one.
versions.redactHint: To remove something that should not be kept, use Redact on the version that holds it. The newest version cannot be redacted: save a corrected version first.
versions.redactedNoteNoName: The name and the text of this version were removed on {{date}}. Reason: {{reason}}.
